description: This file defines a React component for the main page of a note-taking application, managing user authentication, fetching, creating, saving, and deleting notes, and rendering UI components.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from the API and updates state; sets the first note as selected if none is selected.

methods.name: handleCreateNote
methods.description: Creates a new note via API and refreshes the notes list.

methods.name: handleSaveNote
methods.description: Saves changes to the current note via API and refreshes notes.

methods.name: handleDeleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note via API, clears selection, and refreshes notes.
